task: Implement Repro-first candidate-only evidence intake MVP from the decision document.
outcome: User runs repro_probe, repro_review_set, spike_record, spike_review_set, red_green_relation_create/evaluate, regression_matrix_review_set, and story_create_from_repro; the terminal prints stable artifact ids, candidate stage summaries, PASS relation results, and a created/bound story id while candidate artifacts are explicitly marked non-production/non-DONE evidence.
facts: The desired workflow is Red/Spike before Story: capture a failing repro and disposable spike evidence before creating the audited delivery story.
Candidate evidence must not be consumed as DONE or production proof.
The shared evidence platform document defines immutable evidence artifacts and .lattice/evidence storage.
Current worktree does not include the new decision docs because they were untracked in main when the worktree was created; this story must add the relevant docs into the branch.
Command definitions belong in packages/main/src/cli/command-catalog.ts and handlers are registered through packages/main/src/registry.ts.
story_create_from_repro should call createStoryCreateHandlers(ctx).story_create so existing story_create locks, background validation, dedup, and INIT lifecycle rules stay authoritative.
constraints: Do not implement full Proof Admissibility enforcement or Authority Server quorum in this story.
Do not change production DONE gates to consume candidate artifacts.
Do not directly edit docs/story or tests/fixtures storage.
